experiments.name: Equal averaging
experiments.description: Uniform average of ARIMA, RandomForest, and LSTM predictions.
experiments.rationale: Baseline ensemble that tests whether simple diversification is sufficient.

experiments.name: Linear stacker
experiments.description: Constrained linear meta-learner fit on the validation split, then applied to the test split.
experiments.rationale: Learned weighting while keeping the meta-learner simple and interpretable.

experiments.name: Rolling RMSE weighting
experiments.description: Dynamic weights proportional to inverse rolling RMSE from prior observations.
experiments.rationale: Adaptively emphasize the most reliable model without retraining base models.

experiments.name: Signal voting
experiments.description: Majority vote on prediction direction with magnitude from agreeing models.
experiments.rationale: Preserves directional conviction and reduces noise from outlier predictions.

experiments.name: Regime switching
experiments.description: Select a base model based on the detected market regime.
experiments.rationale: Handles nonstationarity by matching model strengths to regimes.

experiments.name: Residual hybrid
experiments.description: ARIMA baseline plus residual correction learned from RF and LSTM deltas.
experiments.rationale: Separates linear structure from nonlinear residuals.
experiments.notes: Residual regression uses a fixed L2 strength shared across experiments.

experiments.name: Confidence weighting
experiments.description: Consensus weighting by inverse distance from the median prediction.
experiments.rationale: Down-weights outlier predictions while remaining fully data-driven.
